note: AGENTS.md is the cross-tool convention read by Codex, opencode, Cursor, Windsurf, Zed and Jules. The others are tool-specific paths. Every pointer file says the same thing and defers to the entrypoint, so instructions live in exactly one place.

agents.name: Any writing or coding agent
agents.protocol: session start -> read context (section, claims, venue) -> write -> update memory -> session end
